description.value: REO Resort is a long-running, award-winning eco-adventure glamping resort perched on the edge of the Nahatlatch River deep in the Fraser Canyon, reached via a forest service road roughly 2.5 hours from Vancouver. Founded in 1982 and still family-operated, it offers all-inclusive packages combining whitewater rafting, yoga, guided canyon hikes, and riverside glamping in hand-peeled log and canvas tents. A touring cyclist willing to venture off-pavement would find a fully catered wilderness base with three chef-prepared meals daily and a TripAdvisor Hall of Fame reputation.

address.value: 61755 Nahatlatch Forest Service Rd, Boston Bar, V0K 1C0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms the OSM address, local phone (604-862-7772), email, and resort name exactly. The resort amenities page lists hot tub, hammock garden, outdoor cedar showers, dining, and glamping tents but makes no mention of bicycle storage, bike procedures, laundry, Wi-Fi, e-bike charging, or any cycling-specific infrastructure. The employment page confirms seasonal operation (May–September). Device charging and Wi-Fi are unmentioned and the resort is explicitly described as 'off-grid,' supporting null rather than true for those fields.
concerns: OSM lists only the local number (+1-604-862-7772); website also prominently lists a toll-free number (1-800-736-7238) as the primary contact.
Resort is seasonal (May–September per employment page); no year-round availability.
Resort is described as off-grid (solar power, spring water); Wi-Fi and e-bike charging availability are unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly bookable wilderness glamping resort with a confirmed web presence, consistent contact details, and 40+ years of operation — clearly useful to touring cyclists seeking remote all-inclusive accommodation in the Fraser Canyon.
enrichment_extras.notes: Access is via Nahatlatch Forest Service Road — cyclists should be prepared for unpaved road conditions on approach.

wow_evidence: Founded in 1982 and still family-operated... TripAdvisor Hall of Fame reputation... all-inclusive packages combining whitewater rafting, yoga, guided canyon hikes, and riverside glamping

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: All-inclusive glamping/rafting resort packages; per-person all-in pricing normalizes to upscale
